icon.title: Tray icon
icon.desc: Trend shows the latest CPU samples as columns, Share lights a grid of dots for the current usage, and Number shows the percentage. All turn amber from 80%.

card.title: Hover card
card.desc: Shows live CPU, memory, GPU and network readings while the pointer rests on the tray icon. When off, the system tooltip shows instead.

menu.title: Right-clicking the tray icon
menu.desc: The quick panel shows live readings, the busiest processes and common actions; the menu lists the common actions only.

moved.title: Tray and components
moved.desc: The tray icon, the quick panel, what closing the window does and the refresh rate in the tray are now on the Components page.

metrics.title: Readings shown
metrics.desc: Chosen readings appear in the order below. GPU readings come from the GPU with the most dedicated memory.

desktop.title: Desktop monitor
desktop.desc: Shows the chosen readings in a small window on the desktop. Drag to move it, double-click to open Argus, and right-click to open the menu. While it is shown, Argus samples at the “Refresh rate”.

locked.title: Lock position
locked.desc: When locked, it can't be dragged.

clickThrough.title: Click-through
clickThrough.desc: Clicks and drags go to the window underneath. Once on, it can be turned off only on this page.

taskbar.title: Taskbar monitor
taskbar.desc: Shows the chosen readings on the taskbar of the main display. Clicking and right-clicking work as they do on the tray icon. While it is shown, Argus samples at the “Refresh rate”.

place.title: Position
place.desc: “Left side” applies only to the Windows 11 taskbar with centered buttons. Otherwise the monitor appears next to the tray.

island.title: Dynamic island
island.desc: Live readings and notifications in a capsule at the top of the screen.

card.click: Click: show or hide the window
